Aug 2026 – Oct 2026

Decoding Pakistan’s Real Estate Market: An Analysis of 18,000+ Listings

NED University of Engineering and Technology

Exploratory Data Analysis of property listings from Zameen.com, Pakistan’s largest real estate portal. The goal was to understand what drives property prices across cities and property types.

0listings cleaned
0Crore PKR, average sale price
0Crore PKR, median sale price

The skew behind the finding

Average4.59
Median2.80

PKR Crore. A few luxury listings drag the mean about 64% above the typical sale price.

  • Cleaned about 18,000 raw listings: removed duplicates and broken rows, and fixed invalid room counts
  • Converted text prices (Crore, Lakh) and areas (Marla, Kanal) into numbers, so I could run real statistics
  • Analysed sale listings only, because rent and sale prices are on different scales, and removed extreme price-per-sq-ft values as likely entry errors
  • Built bar charts and histograms to compare listings, prices and areas by city and property type
  • Main finding: a small number of luxury listings pull the average price up, so the median is a better measure of a typical price
